_comment: Hand-checked station mapping overrides (Phase 0, 2026-10-20). Keyed by GTFS Sweden 3 parent stop_id. trv_signature null = not a Trafikverket location. kind: rail_station | bus_stop | foreign_not_in_trv. Applied by scripts/phase0/q3-station-mapping.mjs after the automatic methods.

25317.name: København Østerport
25317.note: Trafikverket 'Österport'; its coordinate is ~1 km north of the real station, so geo matching fails

72892.name: Dresden Hbf (Strehlener Str.)
72892.note: Trafikverket 'Dresden', 247 m. 'Strehlener Str.' is the station's south side; used by Snälltåget 300/301 variants

622.name: Cityterminalen
622.note: Stockholm bus terminal; SJ 6xxxx replacement buses

24116.name: Kungsplan
24116.note: Karlskrona bus stop; Snälltåget connecting bus 9030x/9394x

20758.name: Centrum väst
20758.note: Ronneby bus stop; Snälltåget connecting bus

18362.name: Brinellgymnasiet
18362.note: Nässjö school halt; Phase 0 timetable evidence (44 votes), 175 m

39696.name: Rottneros
39696.note: Replacement-bus stop ~1 km from the station. Trafikverket files its buses under the station's signature, which fooled Phase 0's timetable votes; the real station is a separate GTFS stop with the official mapping.

38983.note: Göteborg bus terminal used by SJ replacement buses (6xxxx). Trafikverket's 'Gc' (Göteborgs Central) is 73 m away and is the bus location, not the railway station; found when it showed up in station search.
